Plot one pair's co-localisation by outcome

Source: R/plotting.R
plotMetricBoxplot.Rd

Shows, for one pair of cell types or groups, the per-image co-localisation measured with the original labels (unweighted) and with the bootstrap confidence weights (weighted), for each level of the outcome. Each point is one image.

Usage

plotMetricBoxplot(
  results,
  spe,
  fromType,
  toType,
  outcomeCol,
  metric = c("lfunction", "kontextual")
)

Arguments

results

Output of runColocalisationModels().

spe

A SummarizedExperiment (e.g. a SpatialExperiment) with imageID and the outcome in colData.

fromType, toType

The pair to show. An error is raised if the pair is not in the results; relative co-localisation ("kontextual") only has pairs whose toType has a parent other than itself.

outcomeCol

Name of the outcome column in colData(spe).

metric

The measure to plot: "lfunction" (co-localisation, the cross-type L-function) or "kontextual" (co-localisation relative to a parent population, the Kontextual measure).

Value

An interactive plot, a girafe widget that needs the ggiraph package.

Examples

# \donttest{
data(lungSubset)
data(lungCellTypeTree)
data(lungConfList)
res = runColocalisationModels(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree, lungConfList,
    outcomeCol = "disease_status", subject = "subject")
#> Generating comparisons...
#> Testing weighted co-localisation...
#> Coercing condition into factor. Dropping unused levels. Using disease_status = Control as base comparison group. If this is not the desired base group, please convert cells$disease_status into a factor and change the order of levels(cells$disease_status) so that the base group is at index 1.
#> Warning: Your specified subject parameter has a one-to-one mapping with imageID. Converting to a linear model instead of mixed model.
#> Testing weighted relative co-localisation...
#> Testing unweighted co-localisation...
#> Coercing condition into factor. Dropping unused levels. Using disease_status = Control as base comparison group. If this is not the desired base group, please convert cells$disease_status into a factor and change the order of levels(cells$disease_status) so that the base group is at index 1.
#> Warning: Your specified subject parameter has a one-to-one mapping with imageID. Converting to a linear model instead of mixed model.
#> Warning: essentially perfect fit: summary may be unreliable
#> Warning: essentially perfect fit: summary may be unreliable
#> Warning: essentially perfect fit: summary may be unreliable
#> Warning: essentially perfect fit: summary may be unreliable
#> Warning: essentially perfect fit: summary may be unreliable
#> Warning: essentially perfect fit: summary may be unreliable
#> Testing unweighted relative co-localisation...
if (requireNamespace("ggiraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
    plotMetricBoxplot(res, lungSubset, "Mast", "Proliferating FBs",
        outcomeCol = "disease_status")
    plotMetricBoxplot(res, lungSubset, "Mast", "Proliferating FBs",
        outcomeCol = "disease_status", metric = "kontextual")
}
